title: Iron Sepulcher Watch
summary: Rome sent sixty men to find out why the shepherds will not use the old road after dark. Build up the watch camp first, then clear the barrow ruins and take the shrine on the rise. The dead will not come to you: you choose when to wake them, and you can choose to be ready.

victory_conditions.description: Clear the barrow ruins. Both risings of the dead must fall.
Take the shrine on the rise: cut down its guardians, then keep troops beside it until the standard is planted.

optional_objectives.description: Raise a marketplace at the watch camp. Gold buys nothing buried in a barrow.
Break both risings at the shrine. Do not flinch when the ground tears open.

defeat_conditions.description: Fabius falls. The watch ends, and the dead keep walking.
Fabius stands alone, with no soldiers left and no barracks to raise more.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Sixty men and a road the shepherds will not walk after dark. The Senate wants a report. Cut timber, raise the camp, and keep everyone off that barrow until I say otherwise.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: The quartermaster sent gold, and gold does not hold a shield wall. Build a market and turn it into iron. When we do go to that barrow, the archers stand still and let the dead walk onto the shields.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Those are men. Were men. Jupiter keep us. ...Steady. Bones break like anything else. Archers, hold where you stand and let them come to the shields.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Listen. The ground is still moving, and one of them is coming up in robes. That one first, archers. The rest are only bones.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Quiet again. Count the living, bring the builders up, and find out what the dead were sitting on. Then look at that shrine and tell me you want to go up there.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: The hill as well. Of course the hill as well. Shields in front, every bow on the one in robes, and nobody chases anything into that haze.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: It is calling up the last of them, and another priest with them. Whatever comes out of that ground now is all it has left. So is what we have.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Now. Get men onto that shrine and keep them there until the standard is up. Nobody steps off it. Not for loot, not for the wounded, not for me.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: Pull the wounded back to the camp and send for the men we still have. The dead are patient. We can afford to be patient too.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: The lights are out and the ground is quiet. Count them twice and burn what will burn. Whatever was in there stood here before Rome and will stand here after it. Tonight it simply has other business.

commander_messages.speaker: roman_legion_organizer
commander_messages.text: They are getting up again. Do not look at the faces; you will know some of them. Fall back to the road, keep walking, and do not stop to bury anything. It does not stay buried here.

theme: The dead do not rest here. Neither will you.
